verdict.rationale: jo's docs describe scheduling recurring jobs ('Give jo a job and a schedule... without asking each time') and overnight autonomous operation on its own cloud machine that reads incoming info and prepares briefings while the user sleeps, which directly matches background autonomous automations. This is corroborated by the llms.txt probe describing jo as running on an 'always-available cloud computer.' missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of automation reliability, no detail on configuring triggers/conditions beyond simple schedules, and no public API/developer docs for building custom automations.
